vBRIEFInfo.description: Initial vBRIEF draft for the AI Joke of the Day repo scaffold.

plan.title: AI Joke of the Day SPECIFICATION

narratives.Overview: A web app that ingests daily news headlines, retrieves relevant context from Pinecone, generates jokes with LangChain and CrewAI, lets users vote, and emails the joke of the day through Zapier.
narratives.Architecture: A TypeScript shell powers deterministic domain helpers while a Python workflow layer handles Pinecone retrieval, LangChain retrieval chains, CrewAI agents, SQLite persistence, a voting dashboard, and Zapier-based daily delivery.

subItems.title: Create TypeScript, lint, test, and task tooling

narrative.Acceptance: task check, typecheck, lint, and tests are defined for the repo scaffold

subItems.title: Add repo documentation and project rules

narrative.Acceptance: README.md, PROJECT.md, and SPECIFICATION.md describe the product and the MVP boundaries

subItems.title: Implement headline normalization and deduplication helpers

narrative.Acceptance: Pure functions exist for normalizing and deduplicating headlines with tests

subItems.title: Implement retrieval context assembly for RAG and LangChain prompt inputs

narrative.Acceptance: The project has pure helpers that prepare retrieval context for LangChain chains

subItems.title: Implement joke ranking and deterministic winner selection

narrative.Acceptance: Winner selection is deterministic for the same vote totals and timestamps

subItems.title: Implement vote tally and digest helpers

narrative.Acceptance: Vote tally and daily digest helpers can be tested without external services

subItems.title: Build the dashboard view for jokes and votes

narrative.Acceptance: Users can review candidate jokes and vote through the dashboard
SQLite stores votes and supports deterministic ranking updates

subItems.title: Add the daily headline fetch and LangChain RAG retrieval job

narrative.Acceptance: The system can run one daily content generation job from stored headlines and retrieval context

subItems.title: Add the CrewAI joke generation and refinement job

narrative.Acceptance: The agent stack uses role-based CrewAI agents to generate and refine 10 jokes

subItems.title: Add the Zapier email dispatch job

narrative.Acceptance: The winning joke can be handed off to Zapier for daily delivery to a mailing list

subItems.title: Add Pinecone-backed retrieval persistence and query flow

narrative.Acceptance: Headline retrieval uses Pinecone in the Starter-plan-safe AWS us-east-1 region
